assignments.name: text
assignments.value: Take a deep breath in. Hold it for a moment. And slowly release. Feel the tension leaving your body with each exhale. You are safe. You are present. You are exactly where you need to be. Let your mind settle like still water, reflecting the calm of this moment. With each breath, you sink deeper into relaxation. Your body becomes heavy and warm. Your thoughts slow down, drifting like clouds across a vast sky. There is nothing to do, nowhere to be. Just this breath. Just this moment. Allow yourself to simply exist in this peaceful space.
